name: Merret
source:
An adventurer's companion. She is good at taking care of people. Her manners are good as well. But she has a habit of telling lies by exaggerating everything. When she is troubled she digs a hole and buries herself.

[Based on the [url=http://www.littlewitch.jp/home/special/LWRQ/pg115.html]official site[/url]]
